notes: YouTube TV searches now drive the app-rendered A-Z keyboard shown on screen instead of waiting for a native webOS text-focus signal that YouTube never sends. Chat follows the photographed Home-to-Search-to-A path, selects letters and spaces with bounded D-pad presses, and activates the on-screen Search button. Manual grid typing requires an explicit one-shot confirmation that A is highlighted, and automatic results are truthfully marked screen-unverified.
